description: Charming apartment in the heart of the Montorgueil district ParisIdeal location Recently renovated New beddingWelcome to our bright 45 m² apartment, located in the heart of the Montorgueil district in ParisThis lively, semi-pedestrianized neighborhood, both picturesque and central, allows you to fully enjoy Parisian life, with its shops, bars, restaurants, and other must-see attractions just steps away. Easy access to public transportation, with several metro stations within a 5 minute walkThe spaceThe Apartment:3 recently renovated rooms, combining comfort and modern styleNew bedding for restful nightsFully equipped kitchen (cooktop, refrigerator, microwave, coffee maker, etc.) for preparing your meals as you please2 bathrooms, one with a shower, the other with a bathtub, and a toilet in each bathroomGuest accessEntire unitOther things to noteNearby:The Montorgueil Market, famous for its fresh, local produceA multitude of trendy bars, cafes, and restaurants just steps awayEasy access to public transportation, only a 5-minute walk from several metro linesPlease note:Sleeps up to 6 peopleFlexible check-in and check-out (to be arranged in advance)Non-smoking / No pets allowedThe apartment is located in a lively neighborhood, ideal for those who want to soak up the Parisian atmosphere.Whether you're in Paris for business or pleasure, this apartment will be the perfect starting point for your stay. Feel free to contact me with any questions or to check availability.
